name: AeroVironment (AVAV)
teaser: Watchlist for new money. The shares trade about 10% above the Base value. The BlueHalo acquisition transformed the company, already produced a large goodwill impairment and has not yet turned into free cash flow, so a 40% margin of safety is required. The buy zone starts at $86.10.
llms: Drone, loitering munition and defense technology company transformed by the BlueHalo acquisition, valued on forward EV to sales and EBITDA after stock compensation; record backlog but negative free cash flow. Bear $102.31, Base $143.50, Bull $218.17. Verdict HOLD at $158.55 (watchlist for new money), maximum buy price $86.10.
